listing.clients: SELECT json_object('id',id,'name',name,'email',email,'phone',phone,'notes',notes,'color',color,'avatar_updated',(SELECT updated_at FROM client_avatars WHERE client_id=clients.id)) FROM clients WHERE archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE
listing.projects: SELECT json_object('id',id,'client_id',client_id,'title',title,'type',type,'status',status,'due_date',due_date,'price',price,'payment_status',payment_status,'local_folder',local_folder,'notes',notes) FROM projects WHERE archived_at IS NULL AND client_id IN (SELECT id FROM clients WHERE archived_at IS NULL) ORDER BY updated_at DESC
listing.links: SELECT json_object('id',id,'project_id',project_id,'kind',kind,'title',title,'url',url,'service',service,'health',health,'last_checked_at',last_checked_at,'has_password',password_ref IS NOT NULL,'has_thumbnail',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM link_thumbnails WHERE link_id=links.id),'expires_at',expires_at,'download_status',download_status,'notes',notes) FROM links WHERE archived_at IS NULL AND project_id IN (SELECT p.id FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id=p.client_id WHERE p.archived_at IS NULL AND c.archived_at IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC, rowid DESC
listing.socials: SELECT json_object('id',s.id,'client_id',s.client_id,'platform',s.platform,'url',s.url,'label',s.label) FROM client_socials s JOIN clients c ON c.id=s.client_id WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at, s.id
listing.payments: SELECT json_object('id',p.id,'client_id',p.client_id,'client_name',c.name,'project_id',p.project_id,'project_name',j.title,'cents',p.cents,'platform',p.platform,'received_on',p.received_on,'note',p.note) FROM payments p JOIN clients c ON c.id=p.client_id LEFT JOIN projects j ON j.id=p.project_id WHERE p.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.received_on DESC,p.created_at DESC,p.id

upsert.client:
INSERT INTO clients(id,name,email,phone,notes,color) VALUES (:p1,:p2,:p3,:p4,:p5,:p6)
                 ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name,email=excluded.email,phone=excluded.phone,notes=excluded.notes,color=excluded.color WHERE clients.archived_at IS NULL
upsert.project:
INSERT INTO projects(id,client_id,title,type,status,due_date,local_folder,notes)
                 SELECT :p1,:p2,:p3,:p4,:p5,:p6,:p7,:p8 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clients WHERE id=:p2 AND archived_at IS NULL)
                 ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET client_id=excluded.client_id,title=excluded.title,type=excluded.type,status=excluded.status,due_date=excluded.due_date,local_folder=excluded.local_folder,notes=excluded.notes,updated_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') WHERE projects.archived_at IS NULL
upsert.link:
INSERT INTO links(id,project_id,kind,title,url,service,expires_at,download_status,notes)
                 SELECT :p1,:p2,:p3,:p4,:p5,:p6,:p7,:p8,:p9 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p JOIN clients c ON c.id=p.client_id WHERE p.id=:p2 AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND c.archived_at IS NULL)
                 ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET kind=excluded.kind,title=excluded.title,url=excluded.url,service=excluded.service,expires_at=excluded.expires_at,download_status=excluded.download_status,notes=excluded.notes,health=CASE WHEN links.url<>excluded.url THEN 'unknown' ELSE links.health END,last_checked_at=CASE WHEN links.url<>excluded.url THEN NULL ELSE links.last_checked_at END WHERE links.archived_at IS NULL AND links.project_id=excluded.project_id
